title: Lock, biometric
summary: An electronic lock that is keyed to someone's biometric data. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with hacker's kits can pick this lock with a successful DC 19 Intelligence…
markdown: An electronic lock that is keyed to someone's biometric data. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with hacker's kits can pick this lock with a successful DC 19 Intelligence check. Better locks are available at higher prices.
